by
  let f := fun n => Real.exp (-↑r) * ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial
  let g := fun n => ↑r ^ n / ↑n.factorial
  have h : HasSum (∑' n, g n) (Real.exp ↑r) :=
    Real.hasSum_exp r
  refine (HasSum.cong_real (fun n => Real.exp (-↑r)) _).symm.trans h
  rw [Real.exp_neg]
  exact HasSum.mul_const_left (Real.exp (-↑r)) (HasSum.summable_of_hasSum h)
